classificationRules.TENSION: At least one CUSTOMER_PUBLISHABLE claim in the dimension is explicitly TENSION or TRADEOFF, or carries counter-evidence, and at least two distinct public methods contribute.
classificationRules.OPEN: At least one CUSTOMER_PUBLISHABLE OPEN claim contributes and no explicit TENSION rule has precedence; at least two distinct public methods contribute.
classificationRules.CONTEXT_DEPENDENT: At least one CUSTOMER_PUBLISHABLE CONDITION or TEMPORAL_ACTIVATION claim contributes and no higher-precedence rule applies; at least two distinct public methods contribute.
classificationRules.COMPLEMENTARY: Two or more distinct public methods contribute different admitted claim types to the same shared dimension without explicit tension/open/condition precedence.
classificationRules.COMMON: Two or more distinct public methods contribute the same non-conflict admitted claim class to the same shared dimension. COMMON means shared emphasis only, never factual agreement or proof.

COMMON.headline: Shared emphasis: {label}
COMMON.narrative: {count} customer-publishable method claims from {methods} independently contribute to the {label} dimension. This records shared emphasis only; it does not establish a fact or increase truth confidence.

COMPLEMENTARY.headline: Complementary perspectives: {label}
COMPLEMENTARY.narrative: Customer-publishable claims from {methods} contribute different bounded claim types to the {label} dimension. They are retained as complementary perspectives rather than merged into one method conclusion.

TENSION.headline: Tension remains visible: {label}
TENSION.narrative: The {label} dimension contains explicit tension, tradeoff or counter-evidence alongside another customer-publishable method contribution. Both sides remain visible; no method is selected as the winner.

CONTEXT_DEPENDENT.headline: Context matters: {label}
CONTEXT_DEPENDENT.narrative: The {label} dimension includes an explicit condition or authorised timing context across customer-publishable method claims. The cross reading preserves that dependency instead of turning it into a fixed conclusion.

OPEN.headline: Open perspective: {label}
OPEN.narrative: The {label} dimension includes an explicitly open customer-publishable claim alongside another method contribution. The unresolved state remains open rather than being filled by cross synthesis.
